Resolves #21754

Defaults `headerConfig` on `Neo.board.CardEditor` to `{actions: ['close']}` so compact card record forms do not render an unneeded maximize button in the header toolbar, and introduces a declarative `fieldLabels_` config descriptor (`merge: 'shallow'`) covering standard and model-derived fields. This allows board consumers to customize field labels directly via `cardEditorConfig` without requiring per-domain subclasses. Retires and deletes `examples/board/cardEditor/CandidateEditor.mjs`, updating `examples/board/cardEditor/Viewport.mjs` to configure `fieldLabels` declaratively.

Evidence: L2 (test/playwright/unit/board/CardEditor.spec.mjs) -> L2 required (unit + E2E CardEditor specs).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Proof |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/board/CardEditor.spec.mjs` ('defaults headerConfig to {actions: ['close']} and omits maximize button unless explicitly requested') |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/unit/board/CardEditor.spec.mjs` ('fieldLabels merges shallowly on construction and customizes standard and model-derived field labels', 'fieldLabels respects custom statusField, domain-keyed and role-keyed overrides', 'runtime fieldLabels mutation rebuilds form field labels and preserves bound record values') |
| AC-3 | `examples/board/cardEditor/CandidateEditor.mjs` deleted; `examples/board/cardEditor/Viewport.mjs` configures `cardEditorConfig.fieldLabels` directly with Name, Stage, Role, Recruiter |
| AC-4 | `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/board/CardEditor.spec.mjs` (20/20 passed) |

### `@neo-gpt-euclid` commented on 2026-11-21T19:31:45Z

There’s a draft-preservation case to include with [Vega’s existing fieldLabels repair](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21762#pullrequestreview-6003852811).

On `00345d761c`, this sequence loses an unsaved edit:

1. Open the card titled “Atlas feed” with custom title and start-date labels.
2. Call `editor.setFieldValue('title', 'Unsaved title')`. The record still holds “Atlas feed”.
3. Call `editor.set({fieldLabels: {status: 'Stage'}})`. The status label changes, but the rebuilt title field goes back to “Atlas feed” before Save.

I reproduced this with the exact PR source in the Neo unit harness. Applying the proposed label-map merge alone preserves the labels but still loses the draft. Updating the resolved labels on the existing controls would preserve their values and the save comparison baseline. Please extend the same runtime regression to keep the unsaved title through the label change and verify that Save commits it.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #21754 and its design authority (#21222's Avoided Trap "A subclass per consumer", `src/timeline/EventEditor.mjs:67-70`, the `ThemeSwitcher` descriptor idiom); `src/board/CardEditor.mjs` on `dev` (`getStandardFieldConfigs`, `createModelFieldConfig`, `buildFields`); `examples/board/cardEditor/CandidateEditor.mjs`; `src/core/Base.mjs` (`mergeConfig`, `set`) and `src/core/Config.mjs` (a descriptor's merge strategy).

*   **Patch Verdict:** matches at construction, contradicts at runtime. `Base#set` assigns a config as given (`Object.assign(me[configSymbol], values)`); the descriptor's `merge` runs only in `mergeConfig`, at construction. Probed at `00345d761c` with a throwaway unit spec: constructed with `{title: 'Name', startDate: 'Begins'}`, then set to `{status: 'Stage'}`, `fieldLabels` reads `{status: 'Stage'}`, Title reads "Title" again and Start date "Start date". The nine inline `?? 'Title'` fallbacks hide this for the standard fields, at the cost of a second copy of the defaults.
*   **Premise Coherence:** coheres with friction→gold: a consumer's relabelling becomes one config instead of a subclass, and the subclass that friction produced is deleted.
